notes: Xu Xiaosi was a Southern Qi official active around AD 479-500; Wenzhong was his posthumous name.
Han Derang, later renamed Yelü Longyun, was a Liao statesman active from the late tenth to early eleventh century; Wenzhong was his posthumous name.
Li Wenzhong was a fourteenth-century Ming general whose personal name was written 文忠.
Lin Zexu was a nineteenth-century Qing statesman; Wenzhong was his posthumous name.
